original_test_intent: Prove the system remains responsive and error-free through a continuous 24-hour idle residency at 40C/+5% rails, without unintended sleep/hibernate or hidden workload.
original_method: Capture original power/sleep settings, services/workloads, logs and inventory; approve idle definition and disable only specified sleep/hibernate paths reversibly; calibrate environment; establish OS/BMC heartbeat and low-utilization/power bounds; leave DUT undisturbed for 24 hours while logging temperature/rails/power, uptime, wake/sleep events and errors; restore settings/environment and verify health.
manual_activity: Operator controls environment and ensures the DUT remains undisturbed; engineer approves idle/power configuration.
agent_execution_scope: No environment control or PASS claim

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; leaving an SSH session idle is not enough to prove controlled environmental idle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator applies approved reversible idle configuration and supplies continuous artifacts.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 40C, +5% rails, disabled hibernate intent and 24 hours retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a synchronized 24-hour environment, utilization/power, heartbeat and sleep-state ledger.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines idle, preserves/rolls back settings and adds continuous observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A system that silently sleeps does not complete an idle OS soak; background stress invalidates idle power state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing sleep policy may persist after test; absence of logs without heartbeat can mean the host stopped logging.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines idle thresholds, allowed daemons, C-state/power expectations, sleep events and monitoring cadence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All sources align on the idle soak; log clearing is rejected as an unsafe baseline technique.

review_improvement: Distinguishes an active idle soak from sleep or silent loss of monitoring and guarantees power-setting rollback.
independent_technical_reasoning: No errors in a 24-hour gap is not evidence of stability unless the OS remained awake and observable. Heartbeat, uptime and low-activity bounds prove continuous residency in the intended idle state.
